standard.name: EN 9100 (AS9100D)
standard.description: Aerospace Quality Management Systems - Requirements for Aviation, Space and Defense Organizations

categories.name: Aerospace Requirements
categories.description: Aerospace-specific quality management requirements based on ISO 9001:2015

clauses.title: Context of the Organization
clauses.description: Internal and external issues, interested parties needs, scope of QMS
clauses.helpText: Aerospace context including safety criticality and regulatory requirements

clauses.title: Leadership
clauses.description: Top management accountability for QMS, quality policy, roles and responsibilities
clauses.helpText: Management commitment to quality and safety in aerospace operations

clauses.title: Planning
clauses.description: Risk-based approach, quality objectives, planning for changes
clauses.helpText: Risk management including product safety and counterfeit parts prevention

clauses.title: Support
clauses.description: Resources, competence, awareness, communication, documented information
clauses.helpText: Competent personnel, adequate infrastructure for aerospace manufacturing

clauses.title: Operation
clauses.description: Operational planning, design, production, product safety, counterfeit parts prevention
clauses.helpText: Aerospace-specific production controls and safety requirements

clauses.title: Operational planning and control
clauses.description: Process planning, control criteria, control of changes, output requirements
clauses.helpText: Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) for aerospace

clauses.title: Operational risk management
clauses.description: Risk management for operational processes including product safety
clauses.helpText: FMEA, FTA, risk assessments for critical aerospace parts

clauses.title: Configuration management
clauses.description: Control over product configuration throughout lifecycle
clauses.helpText: Configuration control, engineering change management, baseline management

clauses.title: Product safety
clauses.description: Identification of product safety features, controls, and work instructions
clauses.helpText: Safety critical characteristics identification and special controls

clauses.title: Prevention of counterfeit parts
clauses.description: Process to minimize risk of counterfeit/suspect unapproved parts
clauses.helpText: Supplier verification, traceability to authorized distributors, documentation

clauses.title: Design and development
clauses.description: Design planning, inputs, outputs, reviews, verification, validation
clauses.helpText: Design controls per aerospace standards (e.g., DO-254, DO-178)

clauses.title: Control of externally provided processes, products and services
clauses.description: Supplier management, approved sources, supplier quality
clauses.helpText: Supplier approval (AS9003), special process verification (Nadcap)

clauses.title: Production and service provision
clauses.description: Production control, identification, traceability, customer property, preservation
clauses.helpText: Work instructions, first article inspection, special process controls

clauses.title: Control of production and service provision
clauses.description: Controlled conditions for production including work instructions, monitoring
clauses.helpText: Production work instructions, in-process verification, employee authorization

clauses.title: Identification and traceability
clauses.description: Unique identification and complete traceability throughout realization
clauses.helpText: Serialization, lot control, material certification, test records linkage

clauses.title: Control of monitoring and measuring equipment
clauses.description: Calibration, verification, validation of measurement equipment and software
clauses.helpText: Calibration program per ISO 17025, measurement system analysis

clauses.title: Release of products and services
clauses.description: Verification that product requirements are met before release
clauses.helpText: Final inspection, first article inspection, certificate of conformance

clauses.title: Control of nonconforming outputs
clauses.description: Control, segregation, disposition of nonconforming products
clauses.helpText: MRB process, customer concessions, scrap/rework controls, reporting to authorities

clauses.title: Performance Evaluation
clauses.description: Monitoring, measurement, analysis, internal audit, management review
clauses.helpText: Quality metrics, on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, audit programs

clauses.title: Improvement
clauses.description: Continual improvement, nonconformity, corrective action
clauses.helpText: CAPA system, lessons learned, improvement initiatives
